lingual_artery_diameter_mm: lingual artery diameter at origin, adult (anatomical/Doppler series)
facial_artery_diameter_mm: facial artery diameter at origin, adult
inferior_alveolar_diameter_mm: inferior alveolar artery diameter at the mandibular foramen, adult
oral_venous_trunk_diameter_mm: common facial vein / lingual vein calibre, adult. The tree built here drains the ORAL territory only, so its trunk is sized to this, NOT to the internal jugular vein (9-16 mm) - the IJV is that wide because it also drains the brain, which this organ page does not model.

lingual_artery.source: whole-tongue blood flow 0.3-0.6 mL/min/g on a ~70 g tongue; the value used is the midpoint of the implied 20-42 mL/min and is an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE published estimate, not a measurement

facial_artery.source: facial artery flow, adult; ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE published estimate

inferior_alveolar_artery.source: inferior alveolar artery flow; ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE estimate from the mandibular bone + pulp territory it supplies

venous_return.source: venous return = the sum of the three arterial inflows built here; it is NOT an independent measurement

saliva.source: Humphrey SP & Williamson RT, J Prosthet Dent 2001;85:162-9 (unstimulated 0.25-0.35 mL/min, stimulated 1.5-2.0 mL/min; resting contribution submandibular ~65%, parotid ~20-25%, sublingual ~5%, minor glands ~7-8%; on stimulation the parotid becomes the dominant gland at ~50%)

clearance_policy_two_numbers: GROWTH rejects a candidate bifurcation closer than 0.25 mm wall-to-wall to an unrelated tree (0.05 mm for the venous tree against its companion arteries). The SOLVE that follows targets 0.05 mm for every pair, because once seven systems share one oral cavity the binding constraint is anatomy, not a round number: an artery, its companion vein and the duct beside them genuinely lie in wall contact.

lingual_artery.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)

facial_artery.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)
facial_artery.contour_anchored: root only (carotid surface) + crosses the measured mandibular antegonial notch

inferior_alveolar_artery.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)
inferior_alveolar_artery.contour_anchored: both ends on the measured mandibular surface

venous_return.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)

parotid_duct.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)
parotid_duct.contour_anchored: ostium only (from the measured maxillary arch)

submandibular_duct.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)
submandibular_duct.contour_anchored: ostium only (from the measured mandibular arch)

sublingual_ducts.radii_from: structural Murray cube law r = r_term * n_downstream^(1/3)

anchor_provenance.carotid_top_*: measured: the superior-most vertex of the common_carotid_artery mask surface (the carotid bifurcation level), contour-anchored
anchor_provenance.bcv_*: measured: the superior-most vertex of the brachiocephalic vein mask surface, contour-anchored
anchor_provenance.mandibular_foramen_*: measured: the most medial mandibular surface vertex in a 8 mm band midway between the occlusal plane and the condyle. Anatomically correct level, but the foramen itself is NOT labelled in the source - it is placed on the measured surface, not detected on it.
anchor_provenance.mental_foramen_*: measured surface vertex under the second premolar; same caveat as the mandibular foramen
anchor_provenance.parotid_ostium_*: buccal mucosa opposite the maxillary second molar (tooth 17/27), whose position comes from the measured maxillary arch
anchor_provenance.caruncle_*: sublingual caruncle beside the mandibular central incisor (tooth 41/31), from the measured mandibular arch

trunk_calibration_note: r_term = r_trunk_target / N_planned^(1/3), fixed BEFORE growth so the clearance solve runs on the radii that are rendered; the realised trunk diameter above differs from the target only where growth produced a different terminal count than planned. The trunk calibre is CALIBRATED to a published value; it is not an independent measurement. Murray's cube law stays exact at every bifurcation regardless.
companion_vessel_policy: The venous tree is grown against a 0.05 mm clearance from the three arterial trees instead of the 0.25 mm used between unrelated systems, and its terminals are offset 2-4 mm from the arterial terminals. An artery and its companion vein share an adventitial sheath in vivo; forcing a 0.25 mm wall gap between them would be an artefact of the solver, not anatomy.
gap_policy: Anatomical fidelity outranks any fixed clearance threshold. Companion vessels and their ducts really do run with sub-millimetre wall separation, so a gap below 1 mm is reported as measured and is NOT treated as a failure. No segment was deleted and no node was pushed outside its own territory to make a number look better; the solver record above states exactly what moved and by how much.
